articles.title: Powerful earthquake shakes Panama
articles.summary:
📰 정부, 비즈니스, 교통 관련 뉴스
📢 Powerful earthquake shakes Panama
articles.content: Various homes, roads, hotels, government buildings, businesses and churches have sustained structural damage, according to the civil protection system. The USGS had said some casualties were possible and extensive damage was probable. Footage verified by CNN shows several damaged buildings in Penonome, some 70 miles from the epicenter. One video shows a church with a partially collapsed steeple and another building with a crumbled facade. In the popular resort town Playa Venao, a multi-story building collapsed and crushed several cars beneath it.
